penrose_ensemble_benchmark.json.note: Subprocess CPU; includes five fresh starts, with restart invocations counted once.

resources.note: P extrapolation, one core per task, two measurements at 3000/4500 sweeps; excludes scheduler wait and storage. Planning upper range is three times fitted time, not a statistical bound. Memory requests are provisioning, not measurements.

cpu_accounting.note: Sum of recorded process CPU; 300 seconds explicitly allow interrupted-start work, imports, fitting, plotting, bundling and untimed checks. No simulation is omitted intentionally; not an OS-wide audit.

descriptive_residual_diagnostic.status: Post-evaluation descriptive diagnostic only; no refit and no change to the registered gate.
descriptive_residual_diagnostic.interpretation: Mixed-ensemble transfer passes, but long-sweep within-protocol prediction is poor. A universal rare-region law is not established.
